**Main finding — measured, not assumed.** The load-bearing thing I found is that this project's stated platform decision cannot currently be executed at all:

```
xcode-select -p     → /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools
xcodebuild -version → xcode-select: error: tool 'xcodebuild' requires Xcode
```

No `Xcode.app` in `/Applications`, so no iOS SDK and no simulator. Swift 6.3.3 exists, but only as Command Line Tools (macOS host compiler). Machine is an **Intel** Core i5-1038NG7 on macOS 26.5.2. K-07 ("önce iPhone + iPad") therefore has a hard, unmet precondition: today not one line of iOS code can be built here. I recorded it as a measurement plus two explicit `BOŞLUK` lines rather than a decision, because this box forbids sealing architecture — one is `kaynak: araştırma` (does an Xcode installable on this Intel machine still support iOS targets), the other `kaynak: sahip` (paid Apple Developer account).
